source.author: lucan
source.text: Nec piger ignis erat per stuppea vincula perque Manantes cera tabulas: et tempore eodem Transtraque nautarum summique arsere ceruchi.
source.text_original: Nec piger ignis erat per stuppea vincula perque / Manantes cera tabulas: et tempore eodem / Transtraque nautarum summique arsere ceruchi.
source.text_english: Nor was the fire sluggish as it spread through the tow ropes and through the wax that dripped from the planks; and at the same time the benches of the sailors and the topmost mast also blazed.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quin et Cecropiae proles vacat Orithyiae, temperet ut tremulos Zetes fraterque ceruchos.
reuse.text_original: quin et Cecropiae proles vacat Orithyiae, / temperet ut tremulos Zetes fraterque ceruchos.
reuse.text_english: Indeed, the offspring of Cecrops is also free from Orithyia, so that Zetes and his brother may restrain their trembling oars.
